 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    # Full-width/full-height non-background lines are separators.
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]
    rcuts = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    ccuts = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    rblocks = [(rcuts[i] + 1, rcuts[i + 1]) for i in range(len(rcuts) - 1)]
    cblocks = [(ccuts[i] + 1, ccuts[i + 1]) for i in range(len(ccuts) - 1)]

    # The populated compartment is the template; repeat its contents in the others.
    blocks = []
    for r0, r1 in rblocks:
        for c0, c1 in cblocks:
            count = sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            blocks.append((count, r0, r1, c0, c1))
    _, sr0, sr1, sc0, sc1 = max(blocks)
    template = [grid[r][sc0:sc1] for r in range(sr0, sr1)]

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for _, r0, r1, c0, c1 in blocks:
        if (r1 - r0, c1 - c0) != (sr1 - sr0, sc1 - sc0):
            continue
        for dr in range(r1 - r0):
            out[r0 + dr][c0:c1] = template[dr][:]
    return out
"
}
